svg.title: Order life cycle: active states above terminal outcomes
svg.desc: One limit-based lifecycle with a market execution shortcut. Resting limit orders are Open or Partially Filled; either can become Filled, Cancelled or Expired. Market execution never rests and ends Filled, Killed or Blocked. All outcomes are grouped on the bottom row, without outgoing arrows. Killed means partial fill then liquidity exhausted. Blocked means a price bound stopped execution, with partial or zero fill. A valid limit may start Open, Partially Filled or Filled. Empty opposite book market orders revert before this flow. Expired may later display Cancelled, with no resumed execution.
